project_identity.name: Corner Streams
project_identity.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) infused with Archetype 1 (Organic Trust)

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-bold text-[#002147]
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-semibold text-[#002147]
typography.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-[#0056B3]

hero_classroom.description: Hero section background: Nigerian teacher instructing students in classroom

teacher_avatar.description: Professional smiling African female teacher avatar

parent_student.description: African father and daughter looking at tablet together (for Parent Portal feature)

marketing_page.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Deep Navy (#002147) text on white background. Image on the side with a slight overlapping offset. NO full-screen flat overlays.
marketing_page.pricing: Interactive 1/2/3 Terms toggle using Electric Blue (#0056B3) for active state. 'Full Session' tier highlighted with Vibrant Green (#28A745) border/badge.
marketing_page.testimonials: Bento Grid Layout (Tetris style). Generous padding (p-8).
marketing_page.contact: Clean HTML/Tailwind form. Solid borders, distinct focus rings in Electric Blue. Strong IBM Plex Sans labels.

dashboards.sidebar: Deep Navy (#002147) background with white text. High contrast. Electric Blue (#0056B3) hover states for navigation links.
dashboards.main_content: Off-white background (#F8FAFC). Modular widgets with crisp white backgrounds and subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0).
dashboards.spacing: F-Pattern Progress design. Dense but optical alignment. Padding p-6 inside widget cards.

roles.super_admin: God-mode kill switches in Vibrant Green/Red. Global metrics overview.
roles.school_admin: Fee ledger priorities. Debt metrics highlighted.
roles.teacher: Class roster focus. Fast data-entry tables for CA/Exam scores.
roles.parent: Debt lock banner if Balance > 0. Digital report access.

digital_report_card.layout: A4 Print-ready aspect ratio. Header with Corner Streams Logo + School details.
digital_report_card.student_bio: Top section: Photo (Passport image on left), Name, Age, Gender, Class in a grid to the right.
digital_report_card.academic_engine: Table showing CA (Continuous Assessment) + Exam scores = Annual Average & Promotion status.
digital_report_card.skills_rating: 5-star visual representation using Electric Blue (#0056B3) stars.
digital_report_card.footer_signatures: Script font for principal signature. Unique QR code fixed at bottom right for authenticity.

component_guidelines.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary actions use Vibrant Green (#28A745). Secondary/Info uses Electric Blue (#0056B3). Subtle max 8px border-radius.
component_guidelines.tables: High density. IBM Plex Sans 14px. Deep Navy table header background for high contrast. Zebra striping for readability.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn input with 1px solid #E2E8F0. Focus ring in Electric Blue. Left-aligned labels.
component_guidelines.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E2E8F0), no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift, subtle shadow.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
